name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio: Ricardo Alvarez is a Grammy-winning singer-songwriter known for his socially conscious lyrics and vibrant stage presence. He seamlessly blends traditional Mexican folk music with modern pop and rock influences, garnering international acclaim and a dedicated following. While seemingly distant from the racing world, Ricardo is a passionate motorsport enthusiast, often seen attending Formula 1 races and supporting young Mexican drivers. His principled stance on environmental issues and social justice often leads him to use his platform to advocate for positive change, sometimes creating friction with corporations and sponsors. He's also known to hold grudges.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo has a commanding presence and a warm smile. He often wears designer sunglasses, even indoors.

connectionToMotorsport: Ricardo is a vocal supporter of Sergio Perez and other up-and-coming Mexican drivers, often using his social media to highlight their achievements and advocate for greater representation in motorsport. He also performs at exclusive after-parties during the Mexican Grand Prix.
